buyer.notes: Press releases state last-mile focus on urban infill warehouses; IOS criteria cited: easy access to major roadways, functional warehouse with multiple loading doors, favorable zoning, multi-user appeal; proximity to labor, rooftops and transportation corridors. ROI-NJ (2023-12): 'is looking for more in N.J.'. Fourth Central/Northern NJ acquisition since May 2023 was Oakland. NJ deals: Roxbury 470,000 SF newly built (2023); Somerset 110,000 SF new warehouse, first Central Jersey deal (2023); Thornton Logistics Center, Oakland, Bergen County 92,400 SF last-mile (2024); South Amboy 4-acre IOS tract (CBRE); Lumberton (South Jersey). Sibling file says Roxbury was with a Goldman fund (unverified here); Dalfen and Goldman Sachs sold 38 warehouses to Starwood Capital for ~$685M (2025-03).
